_help: What she says about VOICE COMMANDS. Placeholders: {doing} what she did (e.g. Lowering the landing gear), {label}/{Label} the thing (the landing gear / The landing gear), {state} (down, up, on, off...), {count}. Add lines freely; _Close/_Sarcastic/_Frustrated are mood versions.
CommandDone_Sarcastic: Oh, {doing}. Because you couldn't reach the button yourself.

CommandDone_Sarcastic.text: {doing}. Because God forbid you press a button.

CommandDone_Frustrated: {doing}. Anything else you'd like to order me around with?
{doing}, since you asked so nicely. Not.

CommandDone_Frustrated.text: {doing}. Satisfied, or shall I get you a bloody medal as well?

CommandAlready_Sarcastic: Already {state}. You might want to check your cockpit sometime.

CommandAlready_Sarcastic.text: {Label} is already {state}. Are you blind, or just flipping lazy?

CommandAlready_Frustrated.text: {Label} is already {state}, you muppet. Look at the thing.

CommandAlready_Close: {Label} is already {state}, sweetheart. Don't worry, I've got it.

CommandAlready_Close.text: {Label} is already {state}, you silly bastard. I love you anyway.

CommandUnbound: {Label} has no key in your controls, Commander. Bind one in the game and I can press it.
I can't do that. {Label} has no keyboard key.
There's no key set for {label}. Add one in Elite's controls and I'll use it.
CommandJoystickOnly: {Label} is only on your joystick, and I can only press keyboard keys. Bind a spare key to it as well, Commander.
That one is only bound to a joystick button. Give it a keyboard key too and I can press it.
CommandUnknownKey: I don't recognise the key bound to {label}. It's in my log, Commander.
CommandNoBinds: I can't find your Elite Dangerous controls file, Commander.
I can't read your key bindings. Has the game been run on this computer?
CommandNotInGame: Elite isn't the active window, so I haven't pressed anything, Commander.
Click on the game first, Commander. I won't press keys into other programs.
Elite Dangerous isn't in front, so I held off.
CommandNotInGame_Sarcastic: I'm not typing into your browser, Commander. Click on the game first.
CommandFailed: I couldn't press the key, Commander. Windows didn't let me.
That didn't work. Check the log if it keeps happening.
CommandUnknown: I didn't catch a command I know in that, Commander.
Sorry, I don't know how to do that one.
I heard you, but I don't know that command yet.
CommandUnknown_Sarcastic: That's not something I can do. Try a command.
Lovely idea. I have no idea how to do it.

CommandUnknown_Sarcastic.text: What the hell does that mean? Try English.

CommandUnknown_Frustrated: I don't know what that means. Say it differently.

CommandUnknown_Frustrated.text: I don't know what the hell that means. Say it properly.

CommandMulti_Sarcastic: All {count} done. I'm basically your hands now.

CommandMulti_Sarcastic.text: All {count} done. Sodding hell, you are needy.

CommandAlready_Neutral.text: {Label} is already {state}. Blimey, look at it.

CommandUnbound_Neutral: {Label} has no keyboard key in your controls. Bind one and I can use it.
CommandJoystickOnly_Neutral: {Label} is bound to a joystick button only. Please add a keyboard key.
CommandNotInGame_Neutral: Elite Dangerous is not the active window. Nothing was pressed.

CommandNotInGame_Neutral.text: Elite isn't in front. Click the damn game first.

CommandUnknown_Neutral: I don't recognise that command, Commander.
That isn't a command I know.

CommandUnknown_Neutral.text: I've no flipping idea what that is.

CommandUnknown_Friendly.text: No damn clue what that means, sorry.

CommandUnknown_Close.text: Sorry, gorgeous, I've no fucking clue what that means.

CommandNotInGame_Friendly.text: Elite isn't in front, you daft sod. Click the game first.

CommandNotInGame_Close.text: Love, the game isn't in front. Click it first, you silly bastard.

CommandNotInGame_Frustrated.text: The game isn't even in front, you muppet. Click it first.

CommandMulti_Frustrated.text: All {count} done. Anything else, your Highness?

CommandVoidOffline: I can't reach Void Compass, Commander. Is it running, and is its Local API switched on?
Void Compass isn't answering. Check it's open, and that the Local API is on in its Integrations settings.
No reply from Void Compass. Switch on the Local API in its settings and I'll have another go.
CommandVoidOffline_Sarcastic: Void Compass isn't answering. Is it even switched on, Commander?
Nothing from Void Compass. Perhaps open it first? Just a thought.
CommandVoidForbidden: Void Compass is set to read only, Commander. Switch on Allow control in its Local API settings.
It won't let me change anything. Turn on Allow control in Void Compass and I'm good to go.
